exposure: Official Chinese classification of body weight
outcome: Proportion of male and female newborn
Proportion of low live birth weight (<2500 g)
cohort: 2569 Chinese women undergoing their first in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) treatment
finding: BMI was not associated with embryo transfer outcomes after fresh embryo transfer in women undergoing their first IVF/ICSI treatment, but was associated with GDM and gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: The proportion of Cesarean-section was increased with BMI.
